recommendation: Use GO:0016672 as the core molecular function and add one explicit NEW IC molecular-function annotation per PA14 paralog; retain correct existing GO:0015035 and GO:0009055 assertions.

GO:0015035.definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a protein with reduced sulfide groups = a protein with oxidized disulfide bonds.

GO:0016672.definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a sulfur-containing group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces quinone or a related compound.

evidence.readout: DsbA1 oxidation monitored by fluorescence and confirmed by AMS; not a direct quinone-redox measurement.
evidence.controls: Figure2A shows the pre-enzyme trace with reduced DsbA1 and added quinone, followed by rapid oxidation on DsbB1 addition. Main text reports analogous B2 result. Figure5 includes DsbA2-alone and DsbA2-plus-quinone negative controls. No explicit DsbB-containing minus-quinone comparison is displayed in these figures.
evidence.kinetics: Figure2B/C measures substrate-dependent initial velocities for each paralog; apparent Km8.1 micromolar (B1) and9.0 micromolar (B2). These are kinetic constants, not direct binding affinities.
evidence.limitations: Preparations are described as partially purified. Main text says expression in an E. coli dsbB mutant, while TextS2 separately describes BL21C43/pET purification and JFC234/pBAD extract experiments; exact preparation-to-figure reconciliation remains unresolved. Do not claim homogeneous purified enzyme, direct quinone reduction kinetics, a native quinone species, or native DsbA2 pathway activity.

scope: This evidence supports a curated inference of quinone-coupled sulfur-donor oxidoreductase activity. It is substantially more discriminating than the Campylobacter endpoint-only assay that explicitly omitted its no-DsbB control, but is still represented as IC rather than a fabricated experimental GOA row.
new_row_reason: The seed already represents protein thiol/disulfide exchange and electron transfer, but neither GO0015035 nor GO0009055 entails the sulfur-donor/quinone-acceptor combination. There is no existing GO0016491 or GO0016667 row that can legitimately be refined. Controlled reconstitution and substrate-dependent kinetics for this exact PA14 paralog independently support the missing acceptor-qualified MF. Do not MODIFY GO0015035 on a false descendant claim or add a redundant broad oxidoreductase row.
